description: Read OpenVibe.Chat's moderation queues for OpenVibe.Live's moderator pages: a channel's messages held for IP approval, the relay names hidden or banned on a channel (or one by id), and one identity's TTS voice override (plan T3, J4b). Internal: rows carry IP addresses. chat.moderation.read stays the channel settings and moderators read. Loopback only, Chat service token (Live's principal today); never granted to an app or delegated to an agent.
